title: Create asset with valid data (happy path)
objective: Verify an operator can create an asset with all category-driven required fields; response includes UUID, tag, version=1.
preconditions: operator session + CSRF; reference data seeded (category, status, condition, location, department).
test_data: {name: 'QA Laptop 01', category: <Laptops uuid>, status: in_stock, condition: new, department, location, serial_number: 'QA-SN-0001', manufacturer: 'Dell', model: 'Latitude 5540', purchase_price: '1299.99', purchase_currency: 'USD'}
steps: POST /api/v1/assets with payload and Idempotency-Key header.
expected_result: 201 with full asset representation: uuid, server-generated or validated-unique tag, version=1, submitted fields persisted, money represented as {amount, currency} strings; GET returns identical data; created_at/updated_at in UTC ISO 8601 with TZ.

title: Asset tag uniqueness enforced
objective: Verify duplicate tag submission is rejected with 400/409 DUPLICATE_TAG and no second record is created.
preconditions: Existing asset with known tag T (created in TC-FR-003-01 or seeded).
test_data: create payload with tag=T explicitly (if client-supplied tags allowed) or forced collision via API
steps: Verify response and confirm asset count unchanged.
expected_result: Request rejected (400 VALIDATION_FAILED with field_errors.tag, or 409 DUPLICATE_TAG); no duplicate created; tag uniqueness holds for all time including archived records.

title: Missing required fields yield per-field validation errors
objective: Verify 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with field_errors naming each missing/invalid field per the error envelope contract.
test_data: payload missing name and category; payload with invalid category UUID; payload with purchase_price as float-looking string '12.345' or negative; payload with warranty_end < warranty_start
steps: Record status, error.code, error.field_errors keys, correlation_id.
expected_result: Each returns 400 VALIDATION_FAILED; field_errors contains an entry per offending field with user-safe messages; envelope includes correlation_id and retryable=false; nothing persisted.

title: Duplicate warning pre-check endpoint
objective: Verify POST /assets/:uuid/check-duplicates (or create-time warnings) flags possible duplicates by serial number and manufacturer+model without blocking save.
preconditions: Existing asset with serial 'QA-SN-0001', manufacturer 'Dell', model 'Latitude 5540'.
test_data: candidate payload sharing serial_number; another sharing manufacturer+model only
steps: Invoke the duplicate-check endpoint (or create flow returning warnings) with the candidate data.
expected_result: Non-blocking warnings returned listing matched existing assets (tag/uuid + match reason: serial, manufacturer+model); save still succeeds when confirmed; warnings distinguish match types.

title: Asset creation is atomic with lifecycle + audit events
objective: Verify a single create produces exactly one Asset, one initial LifecycleEvent, and one AuditEvent in one transaction.
steps: Record counts of assets, lifecycle events, audit events.
Re-query all three stores for the new asset.
expected_result: Asset + LifecycleEvent(type=created/registered, actor=operator) + AuditEvent(action=create, after=snapshot, before=null, correlation_id matching response) all present; counts each incremented by exactly 1; timestamps consistent.

title: Idempotent create with Idempotency-Key
objective: Verify retrying the same create with the same Idempotency-Key returns the original response without creating a duplicate asset.
steps: POST /assets with key qa-key-0001; record response and new asset UUID.
Repeat the identical POST with the same key.
expected_result: Second response echoes the first (same UUID/tag/status); only one asset created. A different payload with the same key is rejected or flagged per contract (request_hash mismatch).

title: Asset detail returns complete representation
objective: Verify GET /assets/:uuid returns identity, category, status, condition, assignment summary (if any), location/department, technical fields, version.
steps: Validate JSON structure against OpenAPI schema.
expected_result: 200 with all fields per contract; datetimes ISO 8601 with TZ; money as decimal string object; version integer present; response validates against OpenAPI component schema.

title: Update with correct version succeeds and increments version
objective: Verify PATCH with If-Match/version matching current version applies changes and bumps version.
test_data: PATCH {description: 'Updated by QA', location: <new uuid>} with If-Match: N (or version in body)
expected_result: 200; changed fields applied; version = N+1; updated_at advanced; unchanged fields untouched.

title: Stale version update returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT
objective: Verify optimistic concurrency: a second updater with a stale version is rejected and no partial update occurs.
preconditions: asset at version N; two sessions (operator A, manager B).
test_data: A and B both read version N; A PATCHes (now N+1); B PATCHes with stale version N
steps: A and B GET the asset (version N).
A PATCHes with version N — succeeds.
B PATCHes different changes with version N.
expected_result: B receives 409 with code VERSION_CONFLICT and user-safe message; asset reflects only A's changes at version N+1; B's fields unchanged.

title: Material update audited with before/after
objective: Verify PATCH creates an AuditEvent capturing before and after snapshots of changed fields and a lifecycle event where applicable.
steps: Query latest AuditEvent for target_uuid = asset uuid.
expected_result: AuditEvent action=update with before/after JSONB showing old and new values of changed fields; actor, UTC timestamp, correlation_id present; financial field changes excluded from audit for users lacking finance.view? (verify masking policy per design — at minimum event exists and is complete for authorized readers).

title: Asset history endpoint returns chronological lifecycle events
objective: Verify GET /assets/:uuid/history returns reverse-chronological events with actor, timestamp, type, summary.
preconditions: asset with create + at least one update.
test_data: asset from TC-FR-003-01 with one PATCH applied
expected_result: 200 with list ordered newest-first; each event has type, actor, occurred_at (UTC ISO), summary; create event present as oldest entry; pagination envelope if list is long.

title: UI edit form — 409 conflict prompt
objective: Verify the edit page surfaces a clear conflict message when the user's version is stale, offering reload, without losing the user's entered data silently.
preconditions: UI running; two browser sessions on the same asset edit page.
test_data: sessions A and B editing same asset
steps: B changes a different field and saves.
expected_result: B sees a conflict notification naming the issue (changes by another user) with an option to reload latest; B's unsaved input is preserved or explicitly acknowledged before discard; no silent overwrite.

title: UI create/edit form validation UX
objective: Verify client-side validation: required markers, error summary with focus move, per-field errors, values preserved after failed submit, unsaved-changes guard.
test_data: empty form submit; partially-filled form; navigation attempt with dirty form
steps: Observe error summary and focus target.
Fill name only; submit; observe server-driven field errors (missing category etc.).
Fill form partially, then attempt to navigate away.
expected_result: Required fields marked with text+symbol; failed submit shows error summary at top and moves focus to it; per-field errors associated with inputs (aria-describedby); entered values preserved; navigating away with unsaved changes triggers a confirmation guard.

title: Server-side validation cannot be bypassed from the client
objective: Verify submitting invalid data directly via API (bypassing UI validation) is rejected identically.
test_data: payloads violating rules that UI enforces: over-length name, invalid date format, negative purchase_price, nonexistent status UUID, script tag in name field
steps: POST/PATCH each payload directly against the API.
expected_result: All rejected with 400 VALIDATION_FAILED and per-field messages; '<script>' input either stored as inert text (and escaped on render) or rejected — never executed; no 500s.
